units.source_text: 太吉郎当然一眼就看见女儿系着的印花腰带，可他没有正面去看它。

en.t: Taikichiro of course noticed at a glance the printed sash his daughter was wearing, but he did not look at it directly.

units.source_text: 心想：拿印花花色来说，既大方又华丽，而且色彩浓淡有致。

en.t: He thought to himself: as printed patterns went, it was both tasteful and splendid, and the shades of color were well balanced.

units.source_text: 可是，让年轻貌美的女儿系这种腰带合适吗？

en.t: But was it really suitable for his young and beautiful daughter to wear such a sash?
